words.gloss: he who does not conduct himself

literal: Having adapted in that manner not conducting himself, the measure not knowing, himself exalting, quickly will perish.
translation: One who does not live in harmony with others, does not know the measure of his own strength, yet exalts himself, will quickly be ruined.
modern: மற்றவர்களுடன் பொருந்தி வாழாமல், தன் வலிமையின் அளவையும் அறியாமல், தன்னைத்தானே வியந்து பாராட்டிக் கொள்பவன் விரைவாக அழிவான்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the dangers of self-conceit combined with ignorance of one's actual strength and a failure to cooperate with others. The word 'அமைந்து' (amaintu) here means adapting or living in harmony with one's surroundings and associates. 'அளவு அறியான்' (aḷavu aṟiyāṉ) refers to a person who does not assess their own capabilities, resources, or limitations. When such a person additionally 'வியந்தான்' (viyantāṉ)—meaning they self-exalt or hold an inflated opinion of themselves—they lose all sense of reality. Consequently, their downfall ('கெடும்') is not just certain, but will happen very rapidly ('விரைந்து').
